policies.construct_truth: Every result reconstructs the exact predicted edited construct and carries an explicit sequence diff; mutation success still requires clone-level empirical verification.
policies.topology_separation: Q5 back-to-back, QuikChange complementary, QuikChange Multi and NEBuilder multi-site are distinct topologies and cannot be represented as presets of one primer geometry.

agilent-quikchange-lightning-210518.mismatch_spacing_rule: at most 3 consecutive mismatches, or 2 mismatches with at most 9 bases between; protocol-specific
agilent-quikchange-lightning-210518.secondary_structure_review: hairpin at or above 55 C requires review/redesign per manual
agilent-quikchange-lightning-210518.selection: Agilent QuikChange Lightning Site-Directed Mutagenesis Kit 210518/210519
agilent-quikchange-lightning-210518.tm_formula: 81.5 + 0.41(%GC) - 675/N - %mismatch; modified N for insertion/deletion designs per manual

agilent-quikchange-lightning-multi-21051.mismatch_spacing_rule: at most 3 consecutive mismatches, or 2 mismatches with at most 9 bases between; protocol-specific
agilent-quikchange-lightning-multi-21051.primer_dimer_rule: self/heterodimer DeltaG must be greater (closer to zero) than -9 kcal/mol per manual review rule
agilent-quikchange-lightning-multi-21051.secondary_structure_review: hairpin at or above 55 C requires review/redesign per manual
